verdict.rationale: SolidJS explicitly advertises direct DOM access via minimal abstractions for integrating libraries like D3 (solid-gh-8), backed by real dom-as-real-div debuggability (solid-gh-5/12) and community confirmation that Solid is a go-to choice for data-viz work with granular reactivity (solid-comm-7). Missing for 10: no dedicated documentation/tutorial on ref-based DOM manipulation patterns or a broader set of independent case studies beyond the single data-viz comment.
